say:3:1321517001:0.text: Is this the spot you found, Gali?
say:3:1321517001:0.source_cn: 你说的是这个位置吗，伽利？

say:4:1321517002:0.text: Uh-huh, that's right! Isn't it perfect?
say:4:1321517002:0.source_cn: 没错，就是那里！咱们还是一如既往地有默契！

say:5:1321517003:1.text: Alright, go see if you can find those shady guys. I'll stay here and wait.
say:5:1321517003:1.source_cn: 好吧，你们快去找那些可疑的家伙吧。我在这里等你们。

say:6:1321517004:0.text: Got it. We'll be back soon!
say:6:1321517004:0.source_cn: 放心吧，我们很快就回来！

say:9:1321517005:0.text: I'll have my team posted here to keep watch.
say:9:1321517005:0.source_cn: 我也会带人提前守好这里，不用担心。

say:12:1321517006:0.text: Oh, and Melissa, remember to loosen the soil around with a shovel to make it look like someone dug here. Maybe drop a few small items to make it look like you found them—perhaps use the replicas the conservatory sent out last time...
say:12:1321517006:0.source_cn: 哦，对了！梅丽莎，记得要用铲子松一松周围的土，制造出被...

say:13:1321517007:0.text: I know, I know. You don't need to go over everything, I'm not new to this...
say:13:1321517007:0.source_cn: 知道了知道了，不用交代这么多，我又不是第一次考古……！

say:14:1321517008:0.text: Honestly, I can't tell if working with you is a blessing or a curse...
say:14:1321517008:0.source_cn: 唉，真不知道和你搭档是我的幸运还是我的不幸……
